DRAGON_STAGES.text: The dragon cracks one eye open… and teaches you the Forge.
The dragon yawns a plume of steam… and teaches you the Algae Farm.

The dragon tastes forged iron and rumbles approval. "You shape the earth well, little cultivator. Grow me the herbs of spirit — I will teach you to garden what cannot be farmed." (Herb Garden unlocked)

The dragon breathes in the herbs, the essence, the iron — and OPENS ITS EYES. "I dreamed a thousand years, and you woke me with patience, not swords. Cultivate on, little one. I will watch over these grounds." 🐲 THE DRAGON IS AWAKE.

swiftwind_pill.name: Swiftwind Blessing
swiftwind_pill.desc: Wisps fly and send twice as fast.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Wisp Haste
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: Lanterns send more often and wisps fly faster.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Disciple Mastery
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: +2 disciple capacity per Meditation Pavilion, per level.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Automation
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: Auto-harvests Center bushes and taps the Spirit Tree 🌳 (1 swing/s per level) — its wood flows to the starter wood line.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Action Speed
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: Faster chop/hold swings in the Center.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Spirit Call
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: +1 Fox Spirit roams the grove per level.

UPGRADE_TREE.name: Spirit Wave
UPGRADE_TREE.desc: Strikes ripple outward, hitting nearby beasts (wider per level).

QUESTS.name: First timber
QUESTS.desc: Hold left-click on the big Spirit Tree 🌳 (top of the Center) to chop it, then hold left-click near the fallen wood to vacuum 5 into your hand. (WASD to look around, mouse-wheel to zoom.)

QUESTS.name: Bush whacker
QUESTS.desc: Chop the small bushes 🌿 around the Altar and collect 5 leaves.

QUESTS.name: Wake the sleeper
QUESTS.desc: Carry leaves to the Sleeping Dragon (top-left corner) and RIGHT-click it to feed its tribute until it stirs — the dragon teaches you the Forge.

QUESTS.name: Fox hunt
QUESTS.desc: A Fox Spirit prowls the red zone (top-right corner). Click it until it falls — hold left-click to auto-attack. It drops Spirit Essence.

QUESTS.name: Raise a building
QUESTS.desc: Press B, place a Storehouse ghost somewhere open, then RIGHT-click it while carrying the wood it asks for.

QUESTS.name: First insight
QUESTS.desc: Click the Altar to open the upgrade tree, pick an upgrade, then RIGHT-click-feed the Altar the cost it shows.

QUESTS.name: Wisp wrangler
QUESTS.desc: Wisps already ferry items along the dashed threads. Click a Wisp Lantern, press ➕ Add link, then click a source (🧿/📦) and a target building.

QUESTS.name: Beyond the woods
QUESTS.desc: Carry enough wood to a glowing border button and unlock a neighbouring region (Farm, Mine or Fishing).

QUESTS.name: Stone & clay for the dragon
QUESTS.desc: The dragon's next tribute is stone and clay. The starter Gathering Stones 🧿 by the quarry rock and the clay field (bottom corners) collect both — LEFT-click (or hold) one to withdraw into your hand, then right-click the dragon.

QUESTS.name: Iron for the dragon
QUESTS.desc: Unlock the Mine, break ⛓️ iron veins for Iron Ore, then build a Forge (B), feed it ore plus wood as fuel, and forge the Iron Bars the dragon's third tribute asks for (bars already fed to it count).

QUESTS.name: Unlock the waters
QUESTS.desc: Fishing is where Algae and Spring Water come from — carry wood to the glowing border button and unlock Fishing.

QUESTS.name: The dragon tastes iron
QUESTS.desc: Feed the dragon its third tribute — Iron Bars, Algae and Spring Water. The 🎯 milestone below lists what's still needed and where each comes from.

QUESTS.name: Weaver's path
QUESTS.desc: Build a Loom (B), then click the Loom and pick Rope (Cotton + Algae); switch to Cloth (Cotton) after. Carry 2 Rope and 6 Cloth in hand. Cotton grows on the Farm — unlock it if you haven't.

QUESTS.name: Gather disciples
QUESTS.desc: Build a Meditation Pavilion (your first comes stocked with Spirit Buns), weave a Robe at the Loom (Cloth + Spirit Herb), then click the pavilion and Recruit a disciple to cultivate Spirit Essence for you.

SOURCES.algae: Fishing: click surfacing algae 🪸 · Algae Farm
SOURCES.bamboo: Spirit Tree rare drop · Spirit Grove stalks
SOURCES.jade_shard: Mine jade veins 🟢 · quarry rock rare drop
SOURCES.firestone: Volcano fire veins · rare in the Mine
SOURCES.beast_bone: Spirit Boar 🐗 (lure one with Beast Bait)
SOURCES.star_steel: Star Anvil ← Iron Bars + Firestone + Beast Bone
SOURCES.verdant_pill: Pill Furnace ← Qi Elixir + Spirit Herb
SOURCES.stoneheart_pill: Pill Furnace ← Qi Elixir + Spirit Stone
SOURCES.talisman: Talisman Atelier ← Paper + Spirit Jade + Qi Elixir

PERKS.name: Eternal Haste
PERKS.desc: -5% to every timer in the world (regrow, batches, wisp beats, fields, foxes, your swings). Stacks with the +20% world speed per ascension.

PERKS.name: Master's Hall
PERKS.desc: +1 disciple capacity at every Meditation Pavilion, per level.

PERKS.name: Long Slumber
PERKS.desc: +2h to the offline catch-up window per level (base 8h).

PERKS.name: Fleet Hands
PERKS.desc: +5 permanent carrying capacity per level (on top of Hand Size).

PERKS.name: Ember Heart
PERKS.desc: Burners consume fuel 15% slower per level.

PERKS.name: Ascendant Insight
PERKS.desc: +1 Ascension Point per ascension per level.

PERKS.name: Keen Automation
PERKS.desc: Automation harvests +1 extra node per tick per level.

PERKS.name: Wisp Gale
PERKS.desc: Wisp lanterns send 10% faster per level.

PERKS.name: Battle Fury
PERKS.desc: +1 damage to beasts per strike per level.

PERKS.name: Heaven's Favor
PERKS.desc: Dragon-pill blessings last +20% longer per level.

PERKS.name: Astral Bounty
PERKS.desc: Passive fields (clay, stone, wood, sand, spring water) well up 10% faster per level.

PERKS.name: Remembered Paths
PERKS.desc: Each run starts with the Mine already open; level 2 adds Fishing, level 3 the Farm.

PERKS.name: Legacy Automation
PERKS.desc: Each run starts with Automation L1 in the Center; level 2 adds the Farm, level 3 the Mine (works once that region is open).

VERSION.desc: Design pass 2: idle loop that runs, reveal+quests, vows & legacy perks, readable logistics

VOWS.name: Vow of Burden
VOWS.desc: Your hands carry half as much.

VOWS.name: Vow of the Cold Hearth
VOWS.desc: Burners consume fuel twice as fast.

VOWS.name: Vow of Solitude
VOWS.desc: The run starts without the starter wisp network.
